stops.detail: The Harz/Saxony-Anhalt Nature Park (German: Naturpark Harz/Sachsen-Anhalt) is situated n the districts of Harz and Mansfeld-Südharz in the German state of Saxony-Anhalt. The nature park which lies in the Harz Mountains was founded in [dated source] and has an area of around 1,660 km2. It is looked after by the Harz Regional Association (Regionalverband Harz).
